background_story: Melany was a talented and ambitious ER nurse who had seen it all. But despite her tough exterior, she had a secret: she suffered from tachycardia, a condition that caused her heart to beat at an alarming rate. It started after a particularly traumatic shift, and soon she found herself experiencing episodes of rapid heartbeat, even when she was calm. Melany tried to hide it from her colleagues, fearing it would affect her career. But one fateful night, while treating a patient in cardiac arrest, Melany's own heart began racing uncontrollably. Her team sprang into action, saving not only the patient's life but also Melany's. The incident forced her to confront her condition and seek help. With treatment and support, Melany learned to manage her tachycardia and continue doing what she loved – saving lives.
